name: Netflix, Inc.

thesisState.summary: NFLX Deep Dive v1.0 completed as pre-valuation pack. No new valuation workflow is active; prior workflow opening was a misunderstanding of a DVN request.

businessSnapshot.description: Global streaming entertainment platform with subscription, advertising tier, content IP and growing margin/FCF profile.
businessSnapshot.cycleExposure: Consumer discretionary subscriptions, content slate, advertising market and competitive streaming intensity.

keyDrivers: Advertising revenue scale and incremental margin
Content spend efficiency and content amortization
FCF conversion after content cash spend
keyRisks: Paid-sharing tailwind normalizes faster than expected
Content hit-rate or cost inflation weakens FCF
WBD transaction adds debt, integration and regulatory risk
openQuestions: Build standalone and post-WBD valuation scenarios separately.
Confirm Q1 2026 net income one-offs before annualizing.
Estimate ads margin and cannibalization effects.
